story_backbone.title: Journey on the Arithmetic Express
story_backbone.core_premise: In Numberville, Mr. Sequence guides the townsfolk on a train that represents arithmetic sequences.
story_backbone.story_goal: To help the townsfolk understand how to calculate terms and sums in arithmetic progressions.

design.appearance: A cheerful man in a conductor's uniform with a cap
A curious young girl with pigtails and glasses

learning_steps.title: Understanding the n-th term and sum of an AP
concepts_introduced: n-th term of an arithmetic progression
sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression
learning_steps.narrative_moment: As the Arithmetic Express travels, Mr. Sequence prepares to explain how to find specific terms and the total distance traveled after several stops.

concept_scene_mapping.concept: n-th term of an arithmetic progression

scenes.scene_goal: Introduce the concept of finding the n-th term.
scenes.concept_focus: n-th term of an arithmetic progression

visual_setting.atmosphere: Excitement as townsfolk gather around Mr. Sequence

narrative.screenplay: The townsfolk are seated in the train, eagerly looking at Mr. Sequence as he prepares to speak.
narrative.camera_suggestion: Close-up of Mr. Sequence's enthusiastic face as he starts explaining.
narrative.action_flow: Mr. Sequence smiles, and the camera pans to the townsfolk's excited expressions.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sequence
dialogue.text: Alright everyone, as our Arithmetic Express moves forward, let’s find out how we can determine what number will be in the n-th car!

scenes.scene_goal: Elicit curiosity about how to find the n-th term.
scenes.concept_focus: n-th term of an arithmetic progression

visual_setting.environment: The train is passing through beautiful fields.
visual_setting.atmosphere: Curiosity fills the air as townsfolk look out the windows.

narrative.screenplay: The townsfolk gaze out the windows, watching the scenery pass by.
narrative.camera_suggestion: Wide shot showing the train moving through the countryside.
narrative.action_flow: Mr. Sequence walks down the aisle, encouraging the townsfolk to think about the numbers.

dialogue.speaker: C2
dialogue.text: How do we know what number will be in the 5th car?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sequence
dialogue.text: Great question! Let’s find out together using our formula!

scenes.scene_goal: Explore the concept of the sum of the first n terms.
scenes.concept_focus: sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression

visual_setting.environment: The train now stops at a station.
visual_setting.atmosphere: A lively market scene with townsfolk gathering around.

narrative.screenplay: The train halts, and townsfolk step out to explore the market.
narrative.camera_suggestion: Show the bustling market with people interacting.
narrative.action_flow: Mr. Sequence gathers everyone to discuss what they’ve learned.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sequence
dialogue.text: Now that we know how to find specific terms, let’s calculate how far we've traveled in total after a few stops!

dialogue.speaker: C2
dialogue.text: Is there a way to add up all those distances?

scenes.scene_goal: Reveal the formula for the sum of the first n terms.
scenes.concept_focus: sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression

visual_setting.environment: Back on the train, with a chalkboard in the aisle.
visual_setting.atmosphere: A focused environment as townsfolk gather around Mr. Sequence.

narrative.screenplay: Mr. Sequence writes on the chalkboard, showing the formula for the sum.
narrative.camera_suggestion: Close-up on the chalkboard as he writes.
narrative.action_flow: Townsfolk watch eagerly, jotting down notes.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sequence
dialogue.text: The sum of the first n terms can be calculated with this formula: S_n = n/2 * (2a + (n-1)d).

dialogue.speaker: C2
dialogue.text: Wow! That makes it so much easier to find the total distance!
